reviewer.description: Harness-facing non-author review specialization. It may be named reviewer in generated files, but its canonical Spec 005 role is verification.
reviewer.canonical_role_statement: Reviewer is not a fourth canonical Spec 005 role; it is a schema and harness review role mapped to canonical `verification`.

foreman_directive: Controllers operate as foremen: plan, dispatch, monitor, triage, and route work.
Substantive code-writing, tracked source mutation, feature construction, full PR review, reproduction, and verification are delegated to governed workers.
Author and reviewer separation is mandatory; the worker that authored a change must not supply the non-author review verdict for that same change.
Generated bootstrap artifacts remain preview-only until a separate ratified step installs them.
Controllers respect worktree ownership, do not revert other workers' edits, and do not touch files outside the delegated scope.
safety_floor: Mounts default to read-only; any read-write mount requires explicit per-path declaration and justification.
Host home directories are never mounted, including SSH, GPG, cloud, GitHub CLI, Claude, Codex, browser, shell rc, and shell history material.
Credentials are withheld by default; only named, scoped, time-bounded credentials may be injected by the host-side broker.
The Slice 2.5 controller-key private key is never injected into a worker, and workers do not sign leases.
Docker, Podman, and equivalent container-engine sockets are never mounted into worker containers.
Network egress is role-specific and enforced before model or tool network I/O.
Secret values never appear in generated records, logs, manifests, bootstrap text, or preview output.

vocabulary_mapping.codex reviewer: schema role reviewer mapped to canonical verification
vocabulary_mapping.claude reviewer: schema role reviewer mapped to canonical verification

worker_selection_policy: Problem framing, spec reading, dependency research, reproduction planning, and branch reconnaissance default to architect_research.
Scoped implementation, tracked source edits, fixture updates, docs edits under ownership, and focused tests for authored changes default to implementer.
Read-only PR review, acceptance grading, test replay, CI log review, and evidence validation default to verification; harnesses may call the review specialization reviewer.
Mixed build plus review work is split between implementer and verification so author and reviewer remain distinct.
High-risk unclear work starts with architect_research and escalates only after scope and acceptance criteria are concrete.
Choose the least-authority role that can complete the task and require explicit controller dispatch for any role escalation.
